name: @ameforge/atlassian-mcp

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get full details of a Jira ticket by its key. For a single comment (a ?focusedCommentId= link), use get_comment instead.

image_limit.description: Max images to return with include_images (default 5, max 20); the total size cap still applies

include_images.description: Return image attachments (screenshots referenced as !name.png! in the description/comments) as viewable images (default false)

include_worklogs.description: Include the ticket's worklogs with their IDs (default false, one extra request)

tools.name: transition_ticket
tools.description: Change a Jira ticket's status. Matches the transition name or its target status; common aliases (Closed/Resolved -> Done, Reopen -> Re-Open) resolve to whatever the workflow offers. Valid options vary per issue and are listed in the error when no match is found.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Update fields of a Jira ticket. Changing issue_type to or from a sub-task type, or parent_key of an existing sub-task, goes through Jira's Move/Convert wizards; converting to a sub-task needs parent_key. It stops instead of deleting field values the new type cannot hold.

assignee.description: Username to assign, or empty string to unassign

due_date.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string to clear

epic_key.description: Epic ticket key to set as this issue's Epic Link (shows under the Epic's "Issues in Epic" panel, not Linked Issues)

issue_type.description: Issue type name exactly as defined in the project, e.g. Story, Task, Bug, Sub-task, or a custom type like "QA Sub-Task"

parent_key.description: Parent ticket key for any sub-task type (Sub-task or a custom one)

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string to clear

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira ticket

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Replace the text of an existing comment on a Jira ticket. Comment IDs are shown by get_ticket with include_comments.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a Jira ticket. This cannot be undone. Comment IDs are shown by get_ticket with include_comments.

tools.name: get_comment
tools.description: Get one comment of a Jira ticket by its ID, e.g. from a ?focusedCommentId= link. Cheaper than get_ticket when only that comment matters.

include_images.description: Return the image attachments this comment embeds as viewable images (default false)

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search Jira tickets using JQL query language

jql.description: JQL query, e.g. 'project = PROJ AND status = "In Progress"'

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new Jira ticket

issue_type.description: Issue type name exactly as defined in the project, e.g. Story, Task, Bug, Sub-task, or a custom type like "QA Sub-Task"

parent_key.description: Parent ticket key for any sub-task type (Sub-task or a custom one)

tools.name: generate_release_notes
tools.description: Generate Markdown release notes for a fix version, grouped by issue type

tools.name: link_issues
tools.description: Create a link between two Jira tickets

inward_issue.description: Issue key being linked FROM, e.g. PROJ-1

link_type.description: Link type: Blocks, Clones, Relates to, Duplicate, etc.

outward_issue.description: Issue key being linked TO, e.g. PROJ-2

tools.name: unlink_issues
tools.description: Remove a link between two Jira tickets. Direction does not matter. If several links connect them, pass link_type to pick one.

link_type.description: Link type name or verb, e.g. "Blocks", "Relates", "is bug of"

linked_ticket_id.description: The other issue key, e.g. PROJ-2

tools.name: log_work
tools.description: Log work (time) on a Jira ticket, optionally setting WorklogPRO Type of Work and Type of Activity

activity.description: Type of Activity (required when work_type is set): correct, create, review

comment.description: Work log comment. Required when work_type or activity is set (the WorklogPRO form rejects an empty comment)

work_type.description: Type of Work: code, deploy, design, management, meeting, misc, operation, qa, req, research, translation

tools.name: update_worklog
tools.description: Edit a worklog's time, start or comment. Worklog IDs are shown by get_ticket with include_worklogs. To change Type of Work/Activity, delete the worklog and log_work again.

tools.name: delete_worklog
tools.description: Delete a worklog from a Jira ticket. This cannot be undone. Worklog IDs are shown by get_ticket with include_worklogs.

tools.name: add_watcher
tools.description: Add a user as a watcher of a Jira ticket

tools.name: remove_watcher
tools.description: Remove a user from the watchers of a Jira ticket

tools.name: move_to_sprint
tools.description: Move Jira tickets into an active or future sprint, by sprint name or ID

sprint.description: Sprint name (e.g. "PROJ Sprint 12") or numeric sprint ID

tools.name: list_sprints
tools.description: List the active and future sprints of a project's scrum boards, with the IDs move_to_sprint takes

tools.name: find_user
tools.description: Find Jira users by part of a username, display name or email. Returns the username that assignee and watcher fields take

query.description: Part of a name, e.g. "nam" or "Chu Phuong"

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Upload a local file to a Jira ticket as an attachment. Embed an uploaded image in a comment or description with !filename.png!

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to upload; a relative path resolves against the server process's working directory, which the MCP client chooses

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from Jira. This cannot be undone. Attachment IDs are shown by get_ticket in the Attachments line.

tools.name: jira_download_attachment
tools.description: Download a Jira attachment to a local directory, saved under its Jira filename. Attachment IDs are shown by get_ticket in the Attachments line.

dir.description: Absolute path of an existing directory to save into; a relative path resolves against the server process's working directory, which the MCP client chooses

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get full details of a Confluence page by its numeric content ID or by a pasted page URL (viewpage.action?pageId=..., /spaces/KEY/pages/ID/..., or /display/SPACE/Title)

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID, e.g. 123456, or a full page URL

body_format.description: Body representation: 'storage' (default, raw XHTML), 'view' (rendered HTML), or 'none' (metadata only)

body_limit.description: Max characters of body to return (default 40000)

body_start.description: Character offset to start the body slice from (default 0)

save_to.description: Absolute local file path to write the full body to (must not exist); the result then carries metadata only. Use for large pages you want to grep or read in parts

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page. Pass Markdown with body_format='markdown' (converted server-side), or raw Confluence storage format (XHTML) with the default body_format='storage'

body.description: Page content. Markdown when body_format='markdown', else Confluence storage format (XHTML)

parent_page_id.description: Content ID of the parent page, if nesting under one

body_format.description: Format of the provided body: 'storage' (default, raw Confluence storage XHTML) or 'markdown' (Markdown, converted to storage server-side). Use 'storage' for Confluence macros (code, panel, expand, TOC) which Markdown cannot express.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a Confluence page. This is a full replace and auto-increments the version. Pass Markdown with body_format='markdown' (converted server-side), or raw Confluence storage format (XHTML) with the default body_format='storage'; omit body/title to keep existing values

body.description: New page content. Markdown when body_format='markdown', else Confluence storage format; omit to keep existing content

title.description: New title; omit to keep existing title

body_format.description: Format of the provided body: 'storage' (default, raw Confluence storage XHTML) or 'markdown' (Markdown, converted to storage server-side). Use 'storage' for Confluence macros (code, panel, expand, TOC) which Markdown cannot express.

tools.name: patch_page
tools.description: Replace exact substrings in a Confluence page's storage-format body without resending the full body. Pass one old_string/new_string pair, or several in edits to change many spots in one version (applied in order; if any edit fails to match exactly once, nothing is written). Use for targeted edits to large pages where update_page's full-body replace is impractical.

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current storage-format body; must be unique

edits.description: Several replacements applied in order as one page version; use instead of old_string/new_string

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current storage-format body; must be unique

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Move a Confluence page to trash (recoverable). Does not permanently purge

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to move to trash

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a Confluence page (with its children) under a new parent page, including a parent in another space. Content and title are kept; the version increments

parent_id.description: ID of the page that becomes the new parent

tools.name: get_page_by_title
tools.description: Get a Confluence page by its space key and exact title

title.description: Exact page title to look up

body_format.description: Body representation: 'storage' (default, raw XHTML), 'view' (rendered HTML), or 'none' (metadata only)

body_limit.description: Max characters of body to return (default 40000)

body_start.description: Character offset to start the body slice from (default 0)

save_to.description: Absolute local file path to write the full body to (must not exist); the result then carries metadata only. Use for large pages you want to grep or read in parts

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search Confluence content using CQL (Confluence Query Language)

cql.description: CQL query, e.g. 'type=page AND space=ENG AND title~"deploy"', or 'ancestor=123456' for every page under a page (parent=123456 for direct children only). Fields: space,title,type,text,label,creator,created,lastmodified,ancestor,parent. Operators: = != ~ !~ > >= < <= IN. Keywords: AND OR NOT ORDER BY

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List Confluence spaces, or fetch a single space by key

limit.description: Max results (ignored if space_key is set)

space_key.description: Exact space key to fetch a single space; omit to list all spaces

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Resolve a Confluence user's display name and profile from a userKey or username. Useful for turning a page's stored userkey (e.g. from a user mention/link) into a readable name.

tools.name: confluence_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Confluence page. Body must be Confluence storage format (XHTML), not Markdown

body.description: Comment content in Confluence storage format (XHTML), not Markdown

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to comment on

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a Confluence page, 50 per call. When the result has _links.next, call again with start increased by 50

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to fetch comments for

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Attach a local file to a Confluence page. If an attachment with the same name exists, fails unless overwrite=true, which uploads it as a new version. Reference it in the body with <ac:image><ri:attachment ri:filename="..."/></ac:image> or an ac:link

file_name.description: Name to store the file under; defaults to the file's basename

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload

overwrite.description: Replace a same-name attachment with a new version (default false: fail instead)

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to attach to

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of a Confluence page (name, size, media type, version, download link)

tools.name: confluence_download_attachment
tools.description: Download a page attachment (latest version) to a local file. Fails if dest_path already exists

dest_path.description: Absolute local path to save to; must not already exist

filename.description: Exact attachment file name on the page
